title: Account for common stock issuance, including par and no-par, cash and noncash, and issue costs

items.concept: Initial recognition JEs for par cash, true no-par, stated-value no-par, noncash asset exchange, and cash with stock issue costs; paid-in capital rollforward schedule; period-end equity presentation (no remeasurement AJ)
Number-variant twin: par cash, true no-par, stated-value, noncash (asset FV more clearly evident), stock issue costs, rollforward, period-end equity

Lump-sum (combined) stock issuance — proportional allocation when both FVs known; incremental allocation when only one FV known; classification of allocated amounts to CS/PS and PIC; settlement of proceeds among classes
Classification of stock issue costs — capital reduction, not expense
Measurement basis for common stock issued for noncash consideration
